name: Sangen-Jaya
tagline: Shibuya in 7 minutes and Shinjuku in 17 minutes. Served by 2 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000.
summary: The station is in Setagaya City, where Tokyu run 2 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 31 minutes to Otemachi, 17 minutes to Shinjuku, 7 minutes to Shibuya and 33 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. The station stands 32.2 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 8.3 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 32.2 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 25 m to 33.3 m, a difference of 8.3 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 5 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is 0.5 to 3 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the small side for the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 20 clinics and 22 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 青葉会青葉病院, about 2 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 歯科, about 3 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station. Tokyu Den-en-toshi Line run through it. Tokyu Setagaya Line also call here. Both lines are run by Tokyu, so a fault affecting that company can stop them together.
congestion: Tokyu Den-en-toshi Line runs at 138% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 池尻大橋→渋谷, which this station is not on. Tokyu Setagaya Line is not covered by the ministry's congestion survey. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥90,000 to ¥100,000 and 1K ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. 1LDK ¥190,000 to ¥200,000 and 2LDK ¥260,000 to ¥270,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.
drivers: Age and construction of the building
Whether it faces a main road or the railway
Whether it sits at the top or the bottom of a slope

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is on the low side. In plain yen, though, it is on the high side for the 23 wards. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: For quiet, Nishi-Taishido; for rail connections, Sangen-Jaya.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Sangen-Jaya. Nishi-Taishido has only the Tokyu Setagaya Line, so Sangen-Jaya is the better connected. To Toranomon, for instance, Nishi-Taishido takes 7 minutes longer. On quiet, though, Nishi-Taishido comes out ahead.

neighbours.lead: For quiet, Wakabayashi; for rail connections, Sangen-Jaya.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Sangen-Jaya. Wakabayashi has only the Tokyu Setagaya Line, so Sangen-Jaya is the better connected. To Roppongi, for instance, Wakabayashi takes 11 minutes longer. On quiet, though, Wakabayashi comes out ahead.

goodFor: People who want to finish their shopping on foot
People living alone who want to hold the rent down
notFor: The data does not show a drawback particular to this station
noiseSources: The 首都高速3号渋谷線 viaduct runs right beside the station. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
世田谷通り (1 lanes each way) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 12 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: 2 lines serve the station. The choice of connections is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the low side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are lightly loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
